## Listing 文案

### Title

Brewlane Ceramic Pour Over Coffee Dripper, 1-2 Cup, Matte White, Size 02

### Item Highlights

Spiral ribs for even extraction, single hole base, fits most mugs, includes measuring scoop, dishwasher safe stoneware

### Bullet Points

1. Even extraction: spiral ribs lift the paper filter so water flows steadily and grounds bloom without channeling
2. One to two cups: brews 300 to 500 ml per session, sized for a solo morning or a shared afternoon pot
3. Glazed stoneware: holds heat during the pour and rinses clean; dishwasher safe on the top rack
4. Fits most mugs and carafes: 4.5 inch base sits stable on openings from 2.5 to 3.7 inches wide
5. In the box: one dripper, one measuring scoop and a starter pack of 40 paper filters in size 02

### Product Description

Brewlane makes a stoneware dripper for slow, hands-on coffee. Set it on a mug, add a size 02 paper filter, and pour in circles for about three minutes.<br>Rinse after each use. The glaze does not hold odors, so yesterday's dark roast will not flavor today's light roast.
